mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration and economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market expansion (PAYEMS growth > 0%) and industrial contraction (INDPRO < 99.0) indicate economic imbalance, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate > 0 and INDPRO < 99.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 850.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 98.0 signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing market strength (HOUST growth > 0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5%) indicate demand overheating, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth rate > 0 and CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST growth rate > 0 and CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 1.0% during monetary tightening cycles signals aggressive policy, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.
